tracks.instruments: solo piano carries a simple slow melody, warm sustained strings underneath, soft oboe answering the piano, celesta and music-box bells for sparkle, no drums
tracks.mood: tender, wondrous, blissful, quiet awe, a little sad but at peace, grace, late 1990s American film score feel
tracks.extra: very slow, long held notes, space between phrases, piano alone for the first 15 seconds, strings enter, one gentle swell in the middle, thins back to piano alone, gentle fade
tracks.reference: the feeling of the main theme of The Green Mile (Thomas Newman, 1999): style only, our own tune, nothing copied
